name: io.github.Danathar/goodreads-mcp-ai
title: Goodreads MCP
description: Read-only MCP server for Goodreads (no API required): search, books, shelves, ratings

environmentVariables.name: GOODREADS_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric Goodreads profile ID (the number in goodreads.com/user/show/<ID>-name). Default user for the shelf tools; optional, can also be passed per tool call.
